name: Cornerstone Learning
summary: An enterprise learning and talent development platform combining LMS and learning experience capabilities for complex, global and regulated organisations.

accessibility.finding: Cornerstone accessibility statement updated Dec 2025; provides product-specific VPATs on request. Statement scope explicitly includes Cornerstone Learning Management desktop, iOS and Android; WCAG 2.2 AA goal and annual third-party audits.
accessibility.caveat: Request actual Learning VPAT; public statement is not itself the detailed ACR.
